classes.I: invariant — a rule, contract, shape, ordering or boundary that must hold
classes.E: external quirk — the stated cause is outside this code's design (runtime, OS, library, checker, protocol, model)
classes.WJ: workaround justification — the unit justifies a code shape that exists because of a constraint, failure mode or hazard, and names what it avoids
classes.N: narration — restates what the code does, or is a section banner
